item.description:
Dax 3.8.0

  • Background updates now finish installing when your work windows are closed and the Mac is idle. Dax waits for active agents, recordings, uploads and generations, then lets the updater install and relaunch.
  • Dax checks for the latest compatible release at launch and hourly when automatic updates are enabled. Updates that need your permission now show their prompt.
  • Boards have a larger stage, full screen, and @ references. Assets named in a board prompt travel with it, including boards created by agents.
  • Image to Prompt adds Save As and Use actions to the result.
  • Agent progress is easier to read: closed folders show a running dot, and the collapsed indicator rail uses symbols for finished and unsuccessful tasks.

On Dax 3.3 or earlier? Install this release once using the Dax installer. It preserves your saved work and brings you straight to 3.8.0. macOS may ask you to approve replacement and grant permissions to the new app.
